description: Use when an agent is building calldata by hand or filtering logs and needs the exact identifiers: it turns a Solidity signature such as transfer(address,uint256) into its 4-byte function selector and its 32-byte event topic0. Do not use to run the call once you have the calldata (/v1/evm/call) or to hash arbitrary data (/v1/util/keccak256). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

signature.description: Canonical signature: name(type1,type2), no spaces and no argument names.
